title: Weather
description: A weather square that opens out into a five-day forecast.
docs:
Weather — A weather square that opens out into a five-day forecast.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Be Vietnam Pro. If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
